title: Conversational Portfolios — composable lanes for generation, embeddings, and rerank (PRD + launch playbook)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Deliver a compact PRD and launch playbook for a new product concept — Conversational Portfolios — which bundles composable lanes that combine chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank into predictable, versioned endpoint profiles. These lanes provide opinionated latency/cost/quality tradeoffs (fast, balanced, high-quality) and deterministic fallback behavior when capacity or model variants are applied. This ticket defines the requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout and rollback checklist, and operational runbook for launch to Hosted API customers.
background: Customers building multi-step conversational flows currently stitch multiple endpoints and manage composition logic client-side. This increases integration complexity and causes inconsistent quality/cost tradeoffs. Conversational Portfolios offers curated lane bundles (e.g., fast-gen + compact-embed + approximate-rerank) to simplify adoption, provide predictable economics, and enable server-side optimizations (batching, cross-request KV cache reuse, coordinated kernel selection, and graded fallbacks).
goals:
- Provide 3 composable lane profiles (fast, balanced, high-quality) that map to concrete model+config combos.
- Expose a single endpoint surface that accepts a portfolio manifest and coordinate server-side orchestration.
- Ensure rollout with eval-gated quality metrics and canary traffic slices.
- Ship a launch playbook with monitoring dashboards and automated rollback thresholds.
non_goals:
- Not providing an ad-hoc composition language for arbitrary orchestration (this is MVP opinionated only).
- Not supporting on-prem private deployment in the initial launch (Private follow-up ticket planned).
success_metrics:
- Adoption: at least 4 external customers integrate within 6 weeks of GA.
- Performance: fast lane p95 gen latency < 250ms for 90% of requests for 16k context workloads.
- Quality: no more than 2% regression on held-out behavioral evals vs current baseline endpoints.
- Cost: average token unit cost reduction of >= 18% for balanced lane workloads via batching and prefix cache.
- Reliability: canary errors < 0.5% and error budget burn < 10% in first 30 days.
acceptance_criteria: API: /v1/portfolios endpoint implemented with JSON manifest schema, documented in API reference.
Behavior: portfolio lanes must support defined fallback policy: model variant -> regional fallback -> reduced-context fast lane.
Quality: pass eval suite (gen+embed+rerank) with regression < 2% on prioritized prompts and edge-case probes.
Performance: p95 generation latency targets for each lane met on staged canary traffic (fast < 250ms, balanced < 450ms, high-quality < 1200ms for worst-case long contexts).
Cost: telemetry shows batching and cache reduce per-token compute cost by target % in synthetic workload runs.
Observability: Console dashboard exposes per-lane latency, cost, token breakdown, and per-prompt quality deltas; alerting configured for SLA breaches.
Docs: Quickstart, SDK sample (Node/Python), and migration guide uploaded to Confluence and linked in API docs.
Security: automated security review completed and secrets/KMS integration verified for any logging hooks.
Rollout: Canary run at 1% traffic for 48h, 10% for 72h, then progressive to 50% with no critical alerts before GA.
Compliance: data retention and PII handling documented per Hosted-hosting guidelines.
rollout_checklist: Create canary config and routing policy in runtime (ENG-81234) and validate canary isolation.
Run eval harness: generation (2k prompts), embedding similarity (500 pairs), rerank A/B (1000 comparisons).
Enable KV prefix caching for portfolio manifests and validate cache hit rates in staging.
Configure Console dashboards: per-lane p50/p95/p99, token cost breakdown, per-model fallback counts.
Set alerts: error rate > 0.5%, latency p95 > lane target, quality regression > threshold.
Prepare rollback playbook: immediate revert to previous endpoint versions and traffic shift steps.
Publish SDK examples and a migration guide with sample manifest templates.
Coordinate CS/SE outreach: notify pilot customers and schedule 1:1 onboarding sessions.
Run security checklist and record results in the release ticket.
Post-GA: schedule two-week and eight-week evaluation reviews to capture adoption telemetry.
launch_risks: Quality regression when coordinating models across lanes (gen vs rerank mismatch).
Unexpected cost increases for low-token, high-rerank workloads if rerank not gated correctly.
Complexity in debugging multi-model traces without enhanced correlation IDs and traces.
Regional capacity constraints leading to increased fallbacks and inconsistent user experience.
Edge-case prompts causing cascading latency due to synchronous rerank calls in the pipeline.
open_questions: Should portfolios support asynchronous rerank (webhook-style) in v1 or defer to v2? (PM decision required)
What is the canonical manifest size limit for portfolios to protect control-plane resources?
Do we expose per-step timeout knobs to customers or keep timeouts opinionated for safety?
How should billing be presented: per-portfolio aggregated token billing or per-step line items?

decisions: MVP will include 3 opinionated lanes (fast, balanced, high-quality) with fixed timeout and fallback policies to keep surface small.
Synchronous rerank will be supported for balanced and fast lanes initially; async rerank deferred to follow-up ticket after GA.
Billing will surface per-step line items in the Console but aggregate invoices by portfolio for easier customer reconciliation.
